# Laya fixture

Generated by `python make_model.py` from any working directory; stdlib only.

For valid marker positions, `logits[b,m] = 0.1 * float(input_ids[b, marker_pos[b,m] + 1])` and `act_logits[b] = float(qtype[b])`. The attention and marker masks are declared but unused; callers must supply valid indices, including for padded markers.
